dsa_patterns.title: LRU Cache (Least Recently Used)
bullets: Core Pattern: Doubly Linked List + Hash Map (HashMap maps keys to DLL Nodes for O(1) lookup & eviction).
Complexity: Get: O(1) time | Put: O(1) time | Space: O(Capacity) memory overhead.
Edge Cases: Node update moves to head | Capacity overflow evicts tail prev | Duplicate keys overwrite existing node value.

keywords: find two numbers that add up to
dsa_patterns.title: Two Sum / Hash Map Lookup
bullets: Core Pattern: Single-pass Hash Map storing complement (target - current_val -> index).
Complexity: Time: O(N) linear pass | Space: O(N) for dictionary.
Edge Cases: Exactly one solution guaranteed vs multiple pairs | Negative numbers and zero handling.

dsa_patterns.title: Sliding Window Maximum (Monotonic Deque)
bullets: Core Pattern: Decreasing Monotonic Deque storing indices of elements. Pop smaller elements from back before inserting.
Complexity: Time: O(N) amortized (each element pushed and popped at most once) | Space: O(K) deque window size.
Edge Cases: Evict indices out of current window [i - k + 1] | Initial window ramp-up.

dsa_patterns.title: Top K Frequent Elements
bullets: Core Pattern: Count frequencies in Map, then use Bucket Sort array where index = frequency (or Min-Heap of size K).
Complexity: Bucket Sort: O(N) time & O(N) space | Min-Heap: O(N log K) time & O(N) space.
Edge Cases: K equals number of unique elements | All elements have identical frequency.

dsa_patterns.title: Merge Overlapping Intervals
bullets: Core Pattern: Sort intervals by start time; iterate and merge if current.start <= previous.end by taking max(previous.end, current.end).
Complexity: Time: O(N log N) dominated by sorting | Space: O(N) or O(1) in-place.
Edge Cases: Single interval | Completely nested intervals [1, 10] and [2, 5] | Disjoint intervals.

dsa_patterns.title: Course Schedule (Topological Sort / Kahn's)
bullets: Core Pattern: Directed Graph in-degree array + Queue (Kahn's BFS) or 3-color DFS (White/Gray/Black) cycle detection.
Complexity: Time: O(V + E) vertices + edges | Space: O(V + E) adjacency list & in-degree tracker.
Edge Cases: Disconnected graph components | Self-dependency loops (Course A requires Course A).

dsa_patterns.title: Coin Change (Bottom-Up Dynamic Programming)
bullets: Core Pattern: 1D DP array dp[i] = min number of coins for amount i. Recurrence: dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[i - coin] + 1).
Complexity: Time: O(Amount * Coins.length) | Space: O(Amount) array.
Edge Cases: Amount = 0 returns 0 | Unreachable amount returns -1 (initialized to infinity).

system_design_archetypes.title: Distributed Rate Limiter
bullets: Architecture: API Gateway -> Redis Cluster with Lua scripts running Token Bucket or Sliding Window Log for atomic checks.
Trade-offs: Token Bucket allows bursts with low memory; Sliding Window Counter gives smooth rate at cost of slight approximation.
Scale & Failure: Local in-memory fallback cache if Redis cluster degrades | Return HTTP 429 with 'Retry-After' header.

system_design_archetypes.title: URL Shortener (TinyURL / Bitly)
bullets: Architecture: Base62 encoding on 64-bit unique ID (Twitter Snowflake or Range-allocated DB counter) -> 7 chars yields 3.5 trillion URLs.
Storage & Cache: NoSQL / DynamoDB (Key: short_hash -> original_url) + Redis caching top 20% hot links with LRU eviction.
Redirect Logic: HTTP 301 (Permanent cacheable by browser) vs HTTP 302/307 (Temporary, enables real-time click analytics).

system_design_archetypes.title: Consistent Hashing & Virtual Nodes
bullets: Architecture: Hash ring [0, 2^32 - 1]. Both server nodes and keys are hashed onto the ring; key assigned to first node clockwise.
Virtual Nodes: Assign 100-250 virtual tokens per physical node to prevent hotspot skew and ensure uniform distribution.
Rebalancing: When node N joins or leaves, only K/N keys are migrated rather than entire database.

system_design_archetypes.title: Real-Time Chat & Messaging (WhatsApp / Slack)
bullets: Connection Tier: Stateful WebSocket Gateway servers holding active TCP connections, coordinated by Redis Pub/Sub or Kafka.
Message Ingestion: Cassandra / ScyllaDB for write-heavy chat history (Partition Key: conversation_id, Clustering Key: message_timestamp).
Offline Delivery: Push Notification Service (APNs/FCM) triggered when recipient socket is disconnected.

system_design_archetypes.title: Kafka High-Throughput Event Streaming
bullets: Partitioning: Topics partitioned across brokers. Partition key hash ensures strict ordered delivery within each partition.
Zero-Copy Disk I/O: Sequential write to OS PageCache + `sendfile()` syscall bypasses user space directly to network socket.
Consumer Groups: Scaled horizontally up to partition count. Offset commits enable At-Least-Once or Exactly-Once via 2PC transactional producer.

keywords: tell me about a time you resolved a production issue
behavioral_star_matrix.title: Major Production Outage & Root-Cause Resolution
bullets: Situation & Task: Payment webhook processing latency spiked to 45s during peak flash sale, causing cascading timeout failures.
Action: Instated immediate circuit breaker, scaled Redis read-replicas, and optimized unindexed query causing table locks.
Result: Restored sub-50ms latency in 14 minutes; published blameless post-mortem and automated latency regression CI tests.

behavioral_star_matrix.title: Technical Architecture Disagreement & Consensus
bullets: Situation & Task: Team was debating migrating monolithic auth service to gRPC microservices vs optimizing existing connection pooling.
Action: Built a benchmark spike proving 90% of latency was DB connection starvation, not HTTP/JSON overhead.
Result: Saved 3 months of refactor engineering time; deployed connection pool fix that reduced p99 latency by 68%.
